saintapediafeedback: Special page name shown on Special:SpecialPages (canonical page name message key)
saintapediafeedback-button-label: Label on the floating action button and the toolbox restore/open link
saintapediafeedback-hide: Accessible name of the control that hides the floating feedback button for this browser tab
saintapediafeedback-show: Accessible name of the edge tab that restores the floating feedback button
saintapediafeedback-hidden: Live announcement after the reader hides the floating button; explains how to get it back
saintapediafeedback-panel-title: Title of the feedback slide-up panel
saintapediafeedback-panel-subtitle: Instruction text above the category chips
saintapediafeedback-category-inaccurate: Category chip: information is factually wrong
saintapediafeedback-category-outdated: Category chip: content is no longer current
saintapediafeedback-category-needs-detai: Category chip: article needs more information
saintapediafeedback-category-confusing: Category chip: text is hard to understand
saintapediafeedback-category-broken-link: Category chip: links are dead or incorrect
saintapediafeedback-category-other: Category chip: catch-all for other issues
saintapediafeedback-comment-label: Label above the optional free-text comment field
saintapediafeedback-comment-placeholder: Placeholder shown in the comment box in public mode (max 500 chars)
saintapediafeedback-comment-placeholder-: Placeholder shown in the comment box in enterprise mode (max 5000 chars)
saintapediafeedback-email-label: Label above the optional email field (enterprise / enabled mode only)
saintapediafeedback-email-placeholder: Placeholder text inside the email input
saintapediafeedback-success-body: Body text shown after successful submission
saintapediafeedback-error-ratelimit: Shown when the submitter has hit the per-day rate limit
saintapediafeedback-error-nocategory: Shown when user tries to submit without selecting any category
saintapediafeedback-error-captcha: Shown when hCaptcha is missing or failed verification
saintapediafeedback-error-captcha-unavai: Shown when captcha is required but ConfirmEdit/hCaptcha is not configured on the wiki
saintapediafeedback-error-namespace: Shown when API submit targets a page outside configured namespaces
saintapediafeedback-special-page-title: Title of the per-page feedback view. $1 = page name.
saintapediafeedback-special-pagename: Label for the article name field on the page selector
saintapediafeedback-special-submit: Submit button on the page selector form
saintapediafeedback-special-notfound: Error when a page ID is not found
saintapediafeedback-special-nofeedback: Shown when a page has no feedback yet
saintapediafeedback-special-categories: Prefix label before the list of reported categories on a feedback row
saintapediafeedback-status-updated: Confirmation message after changing a feedback row's status
saintapediafeedback-action-reviewed: Button to mark a feedback item as reviewed
saintapediafeedback-action-actioned: Button to mark a feedback item as actioned (resolved)
saintapediafeedback-action-dismissed: Button to dismiss a feedback item
saintapediafeedback-export-link: Wrapper text for the JSON export link. $1 = link.
saintapediafeedback-export-link-text: Link text for the JSON export
saintapediafeedback-view: Right required to view feedback on Special:SaintapediaFeedback
saintapediafeedback-viewemail: Right required to see the optional contact-email field on the feedback dashboard, independent of saintapediafeedback-view
saintapediafeedback-export: Right required to download the JSON export on Special:SaintapediaFeedback, independent of saintapediafeedback-view
saintapediafeedback-toolbox: Toolbox link for editors to open feedback for the current page
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-title: Title of the all-feedback admin dashboard
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-empty: Shown when filters match no feedback rows
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-showing: Pagination summary. $1 = first index, $2 = last index, $3 = total count.
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-page: Label before the article title on a dashboard row
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-page-only: Link to filter/view feedback for only that article
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-filtered-p: Shown when the dashboard is filtered to one article. $1 = article title.
saintapediafeedback-dashboard-clear-page: Link to remove the article filter from the dashboard
saintapediafeedback-lookup-help: Help text under the title lookup form that jumps to the per-article feedback view
saintapediafeedback-filter-page: Label for optional article title field in the dashboard filter form
saintapediafeedback-status-reviewed: Workflow status: editor has seen it
saintapediafeedback-status-actioned: Workflow status: fixed or acted on
saintapediafeedback-filter-category-all: Option to not filter by category
saintapediafeedback-filter-apply: Submit button on the filter form
saintapediafeedback-pagination-prev: Link to previous (newer) page of results
saintapediafeedback-pagination-next: Link to next (older) page of results
saintapediafeedback-bulk-select-all: Checkbox label to select every feedback row on the current dashboard page
saintapediafeedback-bulk-action: Placeholder option in bulk action dropdown
saintapediafeedback-bulk-apply: Submit button for bulk status change
saintapediafeedback-bulk-updated: Confirmation after bulk update. $1 = number of rows updated.
notification-body-saintapediafeedback-ne: Echo body when a free-text comment exists. $1 = comment snippet.
Echo body when only categories exist. $1 = category list.
notification-link-saintapediafeedback-ne: Primary link label on the Echo notification
echo-pref-tooltip-saintapediafeedback: Tooltip on Echo preference for this notification category
echo-category-title-saintapediafeedback: Title of the Echo preference category
saintapediafeedback-access-help: Subtitle on the dashboard. $1 = link to MediaWiki:SaintapediaFeedback-access. Default is administrators (sysop).
saintapediafeedback-toolbox-count: Toolbox link when there are new items. $1 = new count.
saintapediafeedback-toolbox-open: Toolbox link when there are open (new+reviewed) items but no new. $1 = open count.
saintapediafeedback-public-counts: Public chip. $1 = open count, $2 = resolved (actioned) count.
saintapediafeedback-work-note: Label for private editor work notes on dashboard
saintapediafeedback-contact-email: Dashboard line when a submitter left a follow-up email. $1 = mailto link.
saintapediafeedback-work-note-visibility: Hint under the work-note field: who can see it (default: administrators)
saintapediafeedback-actioned-hint: Hint above actioned form encouraging a work note
saintapediafeedback-make-public: Checkbox (default on) to publish resolution on the public list; used on single-item and bulk actioned flows
saintapediafeedback-resolution-is-public: Badge when an item is on the public resolutions list
saintapediafeedback-resolutions-title: Title for public resolutions special subpage without a page
saintapediafeedback-resolutions-page-tit: Title for public resolutions. $1 = article title.
saintapediafeedback-resolutions-need-pag: Shown when resolutions URL has no page id
saintapediafeedback-resolutions-default-: Fallback public text when no summary was entered
saintapediafeedback-resolutions-link: Link from dashboard row to public resolutions for that page
saintapediafeedback-post-talk-link: Checkbox on actioned form to post a short Talk note
saintapediafeedback-talk-section: Talk section body. $1 = feedback id, $2 = article wikilink, $3 = resolutions wikilink.
saintapediafeedback-talk-section-public: Talk section when resolution was published. $1 id, $2 article, $3 resolutions link.
saintapediafeedback-talk-edit-summary: Edit summary for Talk note. $1 = feedback id.
saintapediafeedback-talk-failed: Error message if Talk edit failed
saintapediafeedback-detail-link: Link from a feedback item in the list to its own page, which shows the full status history.
saintapediafeedback-detail-title:
Page title of the single-item view. Parameters:
* $1 - feedback ID
saintapediafeedback-unknown-item:
Shown when a feedback ID in the URL does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the feedback ID
saintapediafeedback-page-feedback-link: Link from the single-item view to the per-article list.
saintapediafeedback-history-heading: Heading above the audit-log table on the single-item view.
saintapediafeedback-history-empty: Shown when an item has no rows in the audit log — either it was never processed, or it predates the audit patch.
saintapediafeedback-history-when: Column header: timestamp of a status change. {{Identical|When}}
saintapediafeedback-history-who: Column header: user who made a status change. {{Identical|Who}}
saintapediafeedback-history-note: Column header: the reviewer note recorded with a status change. {{Identical|Note}}
saintapediafeedback-history-unknown-user: Shown in the status history when the acting user cannot be resolved.
saintapediafeedback-back-to-dashboard: Link from the single-item view back to the full dashboard.
